description: THE DRAFT REPORT AS IT STANDS: its title, what kind of document it is, and every line in order with its POSITION — which is what every other draft verb takes. It is the SAME draft the person is filling in the panel’s Report tab. A screenshot they flicked in this morning is here; a line you add appears on their screen. That is the whole point: a report written while the work happens, by both hands, instead of assembled from memory afterwards. Read-only, and free. Build it with qa_draft_build.
